cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)

# Colour palettes generated by tools/build_theme.py from themes.json. Portable
# data only: presentations turn the values into their own colour types.
add_library(furnace_hmi_theme STATIC generated/hmi_theme.c)
add_library(furnace_hmi::theme ALIAS furnace_hmi_theme)

target_include_directories(furnace_hmi_theme
  PUBLIC
    "$<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include>"
)
target_link_libraries(furnace_hmi_theme PUBLIC furnace_hmi::ui_strings)
target_compile_features(furnace_hmi_theme PUBLIC c_std_17)

if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(furnace_hmi_theme PRIVATE /W4 /WX /permissive-)
else()
  target_compile_options(furnace_hmi_theme PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror)
endif()
